definition: To give something that someone needs.
exampleSentence: The hotel will provide free breakfast for all guests during their stay.

definition: To rest your body on a chair or a seat.
exampleSentence: Please sit near the front so you can see the board clearly.

definition: To be on your feet in an upright position.
exampleSentence: We had to stand in line for an hour to buy the tickets.

definition: To be unable to find something, or to fail to win.
exampleSentence: Be careful not to lose your passport while you are traveling abroad.

definition: To give money for something you buy or a service you get.
exampleSentence: You can pay for your coffee with cash or a credit card.

definition: To come together with someone, by plan or by chance.
exampleSentence: We usually meet our friends at the cafe on Saturday afternoons.

definition: To have something as one part of a whole.
exampleSentence: The price of the trip will include flights, meals and a hotel room.

definition: To keep doing something without stopping.
exampleSentence: After a short break, the speaker will continue her talk about climate change.

definition: To put something in a place, or to choose a time or value.
exampleSentence: Remember to set your alarm for six o'clock before you go to bed.

definition: To get new knowledge or a new skill.
exampleSentence: Children often learn new languages faster than adults do.

definition: To make something different, or to become different.
exampleSentence: You should change your password every few months to stay safe.

definition: To guide a group, or to show the way.
exampleSentence: Our most experienced engineer will lead the new team this year.

definition: To know the meaning of something.
exampleSentence: I did not understand the instructions, so I asked the teacher again.

definition: To look at something for a period of time.
exampleSentence: On rainy evenings we like to watch old movies together at home.

definition: To go behind someone, or to do what instructions say.
exampleSentence: Please follow the signs to find the main entrance of the hospital.

definition: To end an action, or to no longer move.
exampleSentence: The bus will stop in front of the museum in ten minutes.

definition: To make something new that did not exist before.
exampleSentence: Designers use special software to create logos and posters for companies.

definition: To say words out loud, or to use a language.
exampleSentence: My grandfather can speak three languages fluently, including Spanish and French.

definition: To look at written words and understand them.
exampleSentence: Before bed, I usually read a chapter of a good novel.

definition: To use money or time on something.
exampleSentence: Teenagers often spend several hours a day on their phones.

definition: To become bigger, or to help plants develop.
exampleSentence: My neighbors grow tomatoes and peppers in their small back garden.

definition: To move something so that it is no longer closed.
exampleSentence: Could you open the window? It is very hot in this room.

definition: To move on your feet at a normal speed.
exampleSentence: Every morning I walk my dog around the park before work.

definition: To be the best or the first in a game or competition.
exampleSentence: Our school team hopes to win the national championship this spring.

definition: To ask if someone would like something, or to make it available.
exampleSentence: Many shops offer special discounts to students with a valid ID card.

definition: To keep something in your mind, or to bring it back to mind.
exampleSentence: I can never remember where I parked my car at the mall.

definition: To like someone or something very much.
exampleSentence: My kids love building sandcastles when we visit the seaside in July.

definition: To think carefully about something before deciding.
exampleSentence: You should consider the cost carefully before you buy a new laptop.

definition: To start to be seen, or to seem.
exampleSentence: A small window will appear on the screen when the download finishes.

definition: To get something by paying money for it.
exampleSentence: We need to buy milk, eggs and bread on the way home.

definition: To stay somewhere until something happens or someone arrives.
exampleSentence: Please wait here while the doctor finishes with the previous patient.

definition: To give food or drinks to people, or to work for someone.
exampleSentence: The restaurant on the corner will serve dinner until eleven at night.

definition: To make something go to another person or place.
exampleSentence: Can you send me the photos from the party by email?

definition: To think that something will probably happen.
exampleSentence: We expect the package to arrive sometime early next week.

definition: To make something by putting parts together.
exampleSentence: The city plans to build a new bridge across the river next year.

definition: To remain in the same place for some time.
exampleSentence: During the holiday we will stay with our relatives in the countryside.

definition: To drop down toward the ground.
exampleSentence: Leaves begin to fall from the trees when autumn arrives.

definition: To divide something into pieces with a knife or scissors.
exampleSentence: Ask an adult to cut the paper if the scissors are too sharp.

definition: To arrive at a place, or to stretch your arm to touch something.
exampleSentence: We should reach the hotel before dark if the traffic is light.

definition: To make a choice after thinking about it.
exampleSentence: It took me a week to decide which university I wanted to attend.
